mapper.select: SELECT * FROM recommendation_batch WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'CURRENT' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM recommendation_batch WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND request_id = #{requestId}
SELECT * FROM recommendation_batch WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, batch_id, book_id, rank_order AS `rank`, score, reason, evidence_json FROM recommendation_item WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY rank_order
SELECT * FROM recommendation_feedback WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT DISTINCT c.book_id FROM borrow_record r JOIN book_copy c ON c.id = r.copy_id WHERE r.member_id = #{memberId} AND r.status IN ('BORROWING', 'OVERDUE', 'LOST')
SELECT personalization_enabled FROM reader_settings WHERE member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.description, b.version, b.category_id, b.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_copy c WHERE c.book_id = b.id AND c.status = 'AVAILABLE') AS available_copies, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record r JOIN book_copy rc ON rc.id = r.copy_id WHERE rc.book_id = b.id AND r.borrowed_at >= #{cutoff}) AS popularity FROM book b WHERE b.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM book_tag bt JOIN reader_interest ri ON ri.tag_id = bt.tag_id WHERE bt.book_id = b.id AND ri.member_id = #{memberId} ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, popularity DESC, b.created_at DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE recommendation_batch SET status = 'HISTORY' WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'CURRENT'
UPDATE recommendation_batch SET status = 'INVALID' WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'CURRENT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommendation_batch (member_id, request_id, source, algorithm_version, status, generated_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{requestId}, #{source}, #{algorithmVersion}, #{status}, #{generatedAt}, #{expiresAt})
INSERT INTO recommendation_item (batch_id, book_id, rank_order, score, reason, evidence_json) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{bookId}, #{rank}, #{score}, #{reason}, #{evidenceJson})
INSERT INTO recommendation_feedback (member_id, batch_id, item_id, book_id, kind, historical, created_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{batchId}, #{itemId}, #{bookId}, #{kind}, false, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE recommendation_feedback SET historical = true WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND historical = false
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM recommendation_feedback WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND historical = true ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
